items.title: Angola Talking Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I was taking the guitar and asked the piano player, would he mind me trying to learn a little bit? Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. He showed me.

ctx.x: And the guitar players would leave their guitar at our house until the next day. Mm-hmm. Well, I'd be plowing out in the field. I'd plow till my mule would get hot. I'd let them cool off and run to the house and practice a little bit on the guitar and just kept on that way until I learned a note or two. And when I learned a note or two, I came to town and stopped around those juke houses around there where they play piano and things. Mm-hmm. And I was taking the guitar and asked the piano player, would he mind me…
Well, who were the piano players?
